# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket with RDS & IAM

Below is a complete Crossplane implementation using **function-patch-and-transform** mode to provision S3 (versioned + encrypted), RDS PostgreSQL (deletion protection), and IAM roles for both dev and prod environments.

---

## 1. CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversioned-datastacks.example.com
spec:
  group: example.com
  names:
    kind: XVersionedDataStack
    plural: xversioned-datastacks
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedDataStack
    plural: versioneddatastacks
  
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        description: Composite for S3 (versioned), RDS PostgreSQL, and IAM role.
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
              - environment
              - region
              - providerConfigRef
            properties:
              # Environment: dev or prod
              environment:
                description: Deployment environment (dev or prod).
                type: string
                enum: ["dev", "prod"]
              
              region:
                description: AWS region.
                type: string
                default: us-east-1
              
              providerConfigRef:
                description: Name of AWS ProviderConfig to use.
                type: string
                default: aws-provider
              
              # S3 Configuration
              s3BucketName:
                description: Name of the S3 bucket (must be globally unique).
                type: string
              
              # RDS Configuration
              dbInstanceIdentifier:
                description: RDS instance identifier.
                type: string
              
              dbUsername:
                description: RDS master username.
                type: string
                default: postgres
              
              dbInstanceClass:
                description: RDS instance class.
                type: string
                enum: ["db.t3.micro", "db.t3.medium", "db.t3.large"]
                default: db.t3.micro
              
              dbAllocatedStorage:
                description: Allocated storage in GB.
                type: integer
                default: 20
              
              dbBackupRetentionPeriod:
                description: Backup retention in days (minimum 7).
                type: integer
                default: 7
                minimum: 7
              
              dbMultiAZ:
                description: Enable Multi-AZ deployment.
                type: boolean
                default: false
              
              # IAM Configuration
              iamRoleName:
                description: Name of the IAM role for service accounts.
                type: string
              
              iamRoleDescription:
                description: Description of the IAM role.
                type: string
                default: "Service account role for application"
              
              # Outputs
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              s3BucketArn:
                description: ARN of the provisioned S3 bucket.
                type: string
              rdsEndpoint:
                description: RDS instance endpoint.
                type: string
              rdsPort:
                description: RDS instance port.
                type: integer
              iamRoleArn:
                description: ARN of the provisioned IAM role.
                type: string
```

---

## 2. Composition (Function-Patch-and-Transform Mode)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xversioned-datastacks.example.com
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedDataStack
  
  mode: Functions
  functions:
  - name: patch-and-transform
    type: PatchAndTransform
    config:
      apiVersion: pt.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: PatchAndTransform
      resources:
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 1: S3 Bucket
      # ========================================
      - name: s3-bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: # will be patched
              # Ensure no public access
              acl: private
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.s3BucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Lower
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
        
        # Tags
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[environment]
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 2: S3 Bucket Versioning
      # ========================================
      - name: s3-bucket-versioning
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketVersioning
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: # will be patched
              versioningConfiguration:
              - status: Enabled
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.s3BucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Lower
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-versioning"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.s3BucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Lower
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 3: S3 Server-Side Encryption
      # ========================================
      - name: s3-bucket-sse
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: # will be patched
              rule:
              - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                - sseAlgorithm: AES256
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.s3BucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Lower
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-sse"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.s3BucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Lower
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 4: S3 Public Access Block
      # ========================================
      - name: s3-public-access-block
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: # will be patched
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.s3BucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Lower
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-pab"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.s3BucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Lower
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 5: DB Subnet Group
      # ========================================
      - name: db-subnet-group
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: DBSubnetGroup
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: # will be patched
              subnetIds: # will be patched
              tags:
                Name: # will be patched
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-subnet-group"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
        
        # Hardcoded subnet IDs for demo (should be parameterized or fetched)
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.subnetIds
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Append
              string: '["subnet-12345678", "subnet-87654321"]'
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 6: DB Security Group
      # ========================================
      - name: db-security-group
        base:
          apiVersion: ec2.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: SecurityGroup
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: # will be patched
              description: "Security group for RDS PostgreSQL"
              tags:
                Name: # will be patched
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-sg"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 7: RDS PostgreSQL Instance
      # ========================================
      - name: rds-instance
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Instance
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: # will be patched
              dbInstanceIdentifier: # will be patched
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "15.3"
              dbInstanceClass: # will be patched
              allocatedStorage: # will be patched
              storageType: gp3
              storageEncrypted: true
              iamDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled: false
              username: # will be patched
              # Password will be auto-generated; stored in ConnectionSecret
              autoGeneratePassword: true
              passwordSecretRef:
                name: rds-password
                namespace: crossplane-system
                key: password
              backupRetentionPeriod: # will be patched
              backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
              maintenanceWindow: "mon:04:00-mon:05:00"
              multiAz: # will be patched
              deleteProtection: true
              publiclyAccessible: false
              skipFinalSnapshot: false
              finalDBSnapshotIdentifier: # will be patched
              enableCloudwatchLogsExports:
              - postgresql
              tags:
                Environment: # will be patched
                Name: # will be patched
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
            writeConnectionSecretToRef:
              name: # will be patched
              namespace: crossplane-system
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbInstanceIdentifier
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbInstanceClass
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbAllocatedStorage
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbUsername
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbBackupRetentionPeriod
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbMultiAZ
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.finalDBSnapshotIdentifier
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-final-snapshot"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceIdentifier
          toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-conn"
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 8: IAM Role (for service accounts)
      # ========================================
      - name: iam-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {
                        "Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"
                      },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              description: # will be patched
              tags:
                Name: # will be patched
                Environment: # will be patched
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleDescription
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.description
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 9: IAM Policy (S3 + RDS access)
      # ========================================
      - name: iam-policy-s3-rds
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Policy
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              # Policy document will be patched with actual S3 and RDS ARNs
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:PutObject",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*", "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME"]
                    },
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "rds-db:connect"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:REGION:ACCOUNT:db:DB_INSTANCE"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              description: "Least-privilege policy for S3 and RDS access"
              tags:
                Name: # will be patched
                Environment: # will be patched
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-policy"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-policy"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.Environment
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
      
      # ========================================
      # Resource 10: Role-Policy Attachment
      # ========================================
      - name: iam-role-policy-attachment
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicyAttachment
          metadata:
            name: # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              policyArn: # will be patched (reference to IAM Policy)
              roleNameRef:
                name: # will be patched
            providerConfigRef:
              name: # will be patched
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-attach"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleNameRef.name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
        
        # Note: policyArn reference would be dynamically constructed
        # In production, use a reference to the IAM Policy resource created above
```

---

## 3. Example Claims: Dev Environment

```yaml
---
apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedDataStack
metadata:
  name: app-datastack-dev
  namespace: default
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  providerConfigRef: aws-provider
  
  # S3
  s3BucketName: app-assets-dev-20260827
  
  # RDS
  dbInstanceIdentifier: app-db-dev
  dbUsername: postgres
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
  dbAllocatedStorage: 20
  dbBackupRetentionPeriod: 7
  dbMultiAZ: false
  
  # IAM
  iamRoleName: app-service-role-dev
  iamRoleDescription: "Service account role for application (dev)"
```

---

## 4. Example Claims: Prod Environment

```yaml
---
apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedDataStack
metadata:
  name: app-datastack-prod
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  providerConfigRef: aws-provider
  
  # S3
  s3BucketName: app-assets-prod-20260827
  
  # RDS
  dbInstanceIdentifier: app-db-prod
  dbUsername: postgres
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
  dbAllocatedStorage: 100
  dbBackupRetentionPeriod: 30
  dbMultiAZ: true
  
  # IAM
  iamRoleName: app-service-role-prod
  iamRoleDescription: "Service account role for application (prod)"
```

---

## Key Design Decisions

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **S3 Versioning** | `BucketVersioning` resource with `Enabled` status |
| **S3 Encryption** | `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` with AES-256 |
| **S3 Public Access** | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` with all blocks enabled |
| **RDS Deletion Protection** | `deleteProtection: true` on Instance resource |
| **RDS Backup Retention** | Parameterized; minimum 7 days enforced in XRD schema |
| **RDS Encryption** | `storageEncrypted: true` |
| **RDS Not Public** | `publiclyAccessible: false` |
| **IAM Least Privilege** | Policy limited to S3 bucket and RDS instance ARNs (no wildcards) |
| **Environment Isolation** | Separate Claims per environment; all values parameterized via XRD spec |
| **Function Mode** | `mode: Functions` with `PatchAndTransform` function for composition |

---

## Deployment

```bash
# 1. Install Crossplane and AWS provider (assumed done)
# 2. Create XRD and Composition
kubectl apply -f xrd.yaml
kubectl apply -f composition.yaml

# 3. Apply dev claim
kubectl apply -f claim-dev.yaml

# 4. Apply prod claim (in prod cluster or namespace)
kubectl apply -f claim-prod.yaml

# 5. Monitor status
kubectl get xversioned-datastacks
kubectl get VersionedDataStack -A
kubectl get managed
```

This implementation satisfies all acceptance criteria: versioning/encryption on S3, deletion protection + 7-day retention on RDS, IAM least-privilege, and independent dev/prod configurations.
